chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Entertain your families every Friday with something of fruit or meat, so that they may rejoice because of Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended way to treat family members on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophetic emphasis on cultivating joy (farah) within the family unit, specifically linking the spiritual sanctity of Friday (Yawm al-Jumu'ah) with domestic warmth. In Shia tradition, this act of 'atraf' (treating/enjoying) is seen as a means to strengthen marital bonds and ensure that the day of congregational prayer is also a day of familial celebration, reflecting the balance between worship and worldly happiness.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Present your family members during every Friday with something from the fruits, or the meats, until they are joyful with the Friday’.
en.sarwar: 19. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
Every Friday present fruits to your family or meat, so that they become happy because of Friday.’”
